title: Borrow books selection
question: When a librarian records a student borrow, how should book selection work?

options.label: Select multiple books at once
options.thesis: One student form, then a searchable checklist of in-stock titles — tap several books before saving.
options.viewport: New Borrow: student fields, then Books borrowed with checkboxes and available counts; Save creates one loan line per book.
options.risk: List can feel long if the catalog is large — search and in-stock-only filter keep it usable.

options.label: Add books via bottom sheet
options.thesis: Keep the form compact — tap Add books, pick from a searchable sheet, see selected chips on the form.
options.viewport: Selected book chips under Book & dates; sheet lists titles with stock; same due date for the batch.
options.risk: One extra step vs an always-visible checklist.

options.label: Keep one book per borrow
options.thesis: Improve the existing single-book dropdown with search — librarian still loans one title at a time.
options.viewport: Same New Borrow form; book field becomes searchable Autocomplete of in-stock titles.
options.risk: Does not match “books” plural if students commonly take several titles.
